<?php
// gRPC Service: UserPermissionService
// Handles encrypted role storage and permission verification

use Grpc\ServerContext;
use Google\Protobuf\Internal\GPBType;

class EncryptedRoleStore {
    private $cipher = 'aes-256-gcm';
    private $key;
    private $db;

    public function __construct(PDO $db, string $masterKey) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->key = hash('sha384', $masterKey, true);
    }

    public function encryptRole(string $role, string $userId): string {
        $iv = random_bytes(12);
        $tag = '';
        $aad = $this->buildAAD($userId);
        $encrypted = openssl_encrypt($role, $this->cipher, $this->key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag, $aad, 16);
        return base64_encode($iv . $tag . $encrypted);
    }

    public function decryptRole(string $blob, string $userId): string {
        $raw = base64_decode($blob);
        $iv = substr($raw, 0, 12);
        $tag = substr($raw, 12, 16);
        $ciphertext = substr($raw, 28);
        $aad = $this->buildAAD($userId);
        $decrypted = openssl_decrypt($ciphertext, $this->cipher, $this->key, OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag, $aad);
        if ($decrypted === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Decryption failed - integrity check error');
        }
        return $decrypted;
    }

    private function buildAAD(string $userId): string {
        return 'role_binding:' . $userId;
    }

    public function storeUserRole(string $userId, string $role): void {
        $encrypted = $this->encryptRole($role, $userId);
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, encrypted_role, version) VALUES (:uid, :role, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE encrypted_role = :role2, version = version + 1');
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId, ':role' => $encrypted, ':role2' => $encrypted]);
    }

    public function getUserRole(string $userId): string {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare('SELECT encrypted_role FROM user_roles WHERE user_id = :uid');
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        if (!$row) {
            return 'viewer'; // default role
        }
        return $this->decryptRole($row['encrypted_role'], $userId);
    }
}

class PermissionResolver {
    private const HIERARCHY = [
        'viewer' => 0,
        'editor' => 1,
        'admin'  => 2,
        'superadmin' => 3,
    ];

    public function getEffectiveLevel(string $role): int {
        return self::HIERARCHY[strtolower($role)] ?? 0;
    }

    public function canPerformAction(string $action, string $role): bool {
        $requiredLevel = $this->getRequiredLevel($action);
        $userLevel = $this->getEffectiveLevel($role);
        return $userLevel >= $requiredLevel;
    }

    private function getRequiredLevel(string $action): int {
        $actionMap = [
            'read' => 0,
            'write' => 1,
            'delete' => 2,
            'manage_users' => 3,
        ];
        return $actionMap[$action] ?? 3;
    }
}

class UserPermissionService {
    private $roleStore;
    private $resolver;
    private $sessionCache = [];

    public function __construct(EncryptedRoleStore $roleStore) {
        $this->roleStore = $roleStore;
        $this->resolver = new PermissionResolver();
    }

    // gRPC handler: CheckPermission
    public function CheckPermission(object $request, ServerContext $context): object {
        $userId = $request->getUserId();
        $action = $request->getAction();
        $delegatorId = $request->getDelegatorId(); // optional: act on behalf of

        $effectiveRole = $this->resolveEffectiveRole($userId, $delegatorId);
        $allowed = $this->resolver->canPerformAction($action, $effectiveRole);

        $response = new PermissionResponse();
        $response->setAllowed($allowed);
        $response->setEffectiveRole($effectiveRole);
        return $response;
    }

    // gRPC handler: ElevateRole (admin only)
    public function ElevateRole(object $request, ServerContext $context): object {
        $callerId = $request->getCallerId();
        $targetId = $request->getTargetUserId();
        $newRole = $request->getNewRole();

        $callerRole = $this->roleStore->getUserRole($callerId);
        $callerLevel = $this->resolver->getEffectiveLevel($callerRole);
        $targetLevel = $this->resolver->getEffectiveLevel($newRole);

        // Security check: caller must have higher privilege than target role
        if ($callerLevel <= $targetLevel) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Insufficient privileges for role elevation');
        }

        $this->roleStore->storeUserRole($targetId, $newRole);
        return new ElevateResponse(['success' => true]);
    }

    private function resolveEffectiveRole(string $userId, string $delegatorId): string {
        if (empty($delegatorId)) {
            return $this->getCachedRole($userId);
        }
        // Delegation: user acts with delegator's permissions
        return $this->resolveDelegatedRole($userId, $delegatorId);
    }

    private function resolveDelegatedRole(string $userId, string $delegatorId): string {
        $userRole = $this->getCachedRole($userId);
        $delegatorRole = $this->getCachedRole($delegatorId);

        $userLevel = $this->resolver->getEffectiveLevel($userRole);
        $delegatorLevel = $this->resolver->getEffectiveLevel($delegatorRole);

        // Only grant delegation if delegator explicitly has higher role
        // and user already has at least editor level (trusted delegation)
        if ($delegatorLevel > $userLevel && $userLevel >= 1) {
            return $delegatorRole;
        }
        return $userRole;
    }

    private function getCachedRole(string $userId): string {
        if (!isset($this->sessionCache[$userId])) {
            $this->sessionCache[$userId] = $this->roleStore->getUserRole($userId);
        }
        return $this->sessionCache[$userId];
    }
}
